title: Self-citation / auto-copying test (Timm & Schinner) with shuffle, cross-folio, forward and positional nulls

notes: min distance = minimum glyph-level Levenshtein distance to words of the comparison line(s)
asymmetry uses exact hypergeometric expected minimum over a random subset of size m = min(n_back, n_forward) so both sides have identical candidate counts
cross-folio null draws a running-text line of the same clean-word count from a different folio of the same (language, hand, section); fallback (language, section) -> language -> all
CIs are folio-cluster bootstrap percentiles; asymmetry p-values are folio-level sign-flip (time-reversal) tests; shuffle p-values are one-sided permutation tests

alignment: rel. position of best-matching word(s) in comparison line vs token position; expected value is exact under random permutation of word slots in that line; strict = token and candidates interior (not line-initial/final) and best distance <= 1
